text:
Maya: Heads-up: deploybot is proposing to unpin runtime-3.0 -> default for prod during the maintenance window (03:00 UTC). Theres a potential SDK binding edge-case for a handful of customers.

deploybot: Proposal: unpin runtime-3.0 -> prod; window=2026-03-25T03:00Z; canary=us-east; prechecks=kv-cache,model-bind-check. Reply with :approve: or :hold:.

Ravi: Quick context: SDK 4.0.1 introduced a subtle file-descriptor leak for model binding on runtimes with new allocator. Patch lands later today but not yet hotfixed in hosted SDK.

Liz: How many active customers use that binding pattern? Can we exclude them specifically instead of model-family routing?

Maya: We have 3 customers identified by customer_id: C-342, C-781, C-999. Option: add an exclusion rule so requests from those customer_ids stay on runtime-2.9 until SDK hotfix is deployed.

deploybot: Suggested exclusion rule:
```
route_exceptions:
  - when: request.customer_id in ["C-342","C-781","C-999"]
    action: keep_runtime
    runtime: runtime-2.9
    ttl: 12h
```

Ravi: That should be low-risk. Also propose rollout throttle: 15% first 30m, then 50% next hour. Keep an automated rollback threshold: error-rate > 1.5x baseline for 10m -> rollback.

ops-bot: Alert and rollback policy created: threshold=error-rate > 1.5x baseline for 10m -> trigger rollback to runtime-2.9 and notify #eng-oncall. Metrics will post to #eng-releases-metrics.

Liz: Please add a line to release notes for support triage: "Customers C-342,C-781,C-999 will remain on runtime-2.9 temporarily due to SDK binding fixes; full migration expected after SDK-1456 deploy."

Maya: Will post release note 20m before window. Plan: (1) Apply exclusion rule, (2) unpin runtime-3.0 at 03:00 UTC with rollout 15%/30m, (3) monitor alerts, (4) if safe, proceed to 50% and then full. If rollback triggers, ops will flip pin back.

Ravi: I'll fast-track the SDK hotfix and post ETA.

Liz: LGTM. Marking :approve: assuming exclusion rule is applied and rollback auto-thresholds are live.

deploybot: Action queued: unpin runtime-3.0 -> prod at 2026-03-25T03:00Z; rollout phases configured; prechecks passed.

Maya: Thanks team. I'll stay oncall during the window and coordinate with support. End of thread.
